title: PokemonEvolutionEntry
description: Schema for one entry in src/pokemon/evolutions/entries. See src/pokemon/evolutions/README.md for the chain-type walkthrough this schema encodes.

_id.description: Unique id for the evolution chain, shared by every line stored in `evolution`

generation.description: Generation the base (first) evolution line was introduced in

evolution.description: One entry per distinct chain line: index 0 is the base line, any further entries are alternate-form lines (e.g. a regional variant)

pokemonId.description: national-dex _id; alternate forms use a decimal suffix, e.g. 19.1 for Alolan Rattata

stage.title: Stage
stage.description: A single Pokemon within a chain: [pokemon_id] or [pokemon_id, how]. `how` is omitted for the first stage of a chain line

items.description: How this stage is reached from the stage before it

chain.title: Chain
chain.description: An ordered evolution line: a stage, followed by the stage(s)/branch(es) it can evolve into

branch.title: Branch
branch.description: A split point where the preceding stage can evolve into more than one thing. Each option is either a single terminal stage (multiple chaining, e.g. Gloom -> Vileplume | Bellossom) or its own continuing chain (multiple continuation chaining, e.g. Nincada -> Ninjask | [Ninjask, Shedinja])
